appDescription: Reduces passenger motion sickness by announcing upcoming vehicle motion and adjusting airflow and seat ventilation.

function.name: START_MOTION_SICKNESS_RELIEF
function.description: Turn on motion sickness relief for passengers when someone in the car feels carsick.

function.name: STOP_MOTION_SICKNESS_RELIEF
function.description: Turn off the manual motion sickness relief and return to automatic mode.

function.name: REQUEST_COMFORTABLE_ROUTE
function.description: Re-route the current navigation using the comfortable route option with fewer sharp turns.
